newsitem.title: ITALY: Maximum rate 8.08 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.
newsitem.headline: Maximum rate 8.08 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.

text.p: The maximum rate at today's 7.0 trillion lire ten-day Bank of Italy reverse repurchase tender was 8.08 percent, compared with 8.03 percent at the previous reverse repo tender, the Bank said.
The average rate was 8.05 percent against 8.03 percent at the last repurchase pact for 4.0 trillion lire and 15 days on November 11.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for repurchase on November 25. The Bank said it received 42 bids of which 21 were met in full and one in part.
